text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: prod/us-west — p95 latency for /v1/generate climbed to ~1.2s (baseline ~220ms). Metric source: edge-traces. Paging oncall SRE.

alex.sre: I'm on it. seeing the spike in dashboards. thanks for the ping.

maria.backend: confirmed — p50 up slightly, p95+ and tail tokens causing the issue. error rate is flat, so likely queuing/backpressure not errors. KV cache hit rate for model-xx dropped from 94% -> 54% in last 7m.

jordan.prod: no prod deploys in last hour. autoscaling looks healthy but some workers with high host CPU (90%).

alex.sre: ok let's try a quick mitigation: warm the KV cache and divert a small % of traffic to canary instances with cached weights. Can anyone kick a cache warming job? @maria?

maria.backend: starting warming job now (script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --model model-xx --region us-west`) — will stream logs here.

ops-bot: JOB STARTED: warm_kv.sh by maria.backend. ETA ~4m. Logs: connecting to cache shards, preloading prefixes.

alex.sre: also bumping the inference concurrency on the oldest pool to reduce queue length: `rbctl scale pool inference-old --concurrency 32` — monitoring.

pat.ops: FYI I'm putting a small routing rule in to shift 10% traffic to eu-west failover while we stabilize (policy: latency-fallback). Will keep at 10% to avoid capacity shock.

alex.sre: good. tess, can we draft a short customer advisory for status page? Need to call out degraded latency for a subset of requests in us-west, no errors, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-45m.

tess.support: drafting now. Proposed status page update (draft):
```
Summary: Some customers in us-west may experience increased response latency for text generation endpoints.
Impact: Elevated p95 latency for /v1/generate; no request failures observed.
Mitigation: Warming caching layer and shifting a small portion of traffic to fallback region.
ETA: We expect progressive recovery within ~30-45 minutes; updates will follow.
```

alex.sre: LGTM. Add: customers using dedicated clusters may see less impact; mention we will post an actionable follow-up if impact changes.

maria.backend: warming job logs: cache hit rate climbing to 78% after preload of top prefixes. p95 trending down from 1.2s -> 480ms in last 3m.

jordan.prod: frontend tracing shows fewer long-tail KV misses — looks correlated.

alex.sre: nice. keep warming until hit rate >90% or p95 stable near baseline. I'll keep watch for 15m then start handoff.

pat.ops: status page update pushed to staging; will publish in 2m unless we want to wait for more improvement.

tess.support: support notify template ready if customers ask: "We're investigating increased latency in us-west for generation requests. We're actively warming caches and routing small traffic to fallback regions; expected restoration within 30-45 minutes. We'll update in 15 minutes or sooner."

alex.sre: publish now and ping @support. I'll remain primary until 3101235667 then handoff to pat.ops for overnight monitoring.

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: status page posted, traffic shift applied (10% -> eu-west), cache warmup in progress.

maria.backend: p95 now ~300ms and rising cache hit stable at 91%. warming job finished.

alex.sre: great work. leaving final checks for 10m, then I will add runbook note and escalate to postmortem if we see recurrence. handing to @pat.ops at 3101235667 as planned.

pat.ops: acknowledged, taking handoff at 3101235667. will monitor overnight and add customer follow-up if needed. :thumbsup:
